title: GenWave Jingle Pack Catalog Entry Metadata
description: The <slug>.meta.json shape for a kind:"jingle-pack" entry (app repo SPEC F165, catalog-owned). Mirrors ad-pack-meta.schema.json's posture exactly (additionalProperties false — this document belongs entirely to the catalog, so an unrecognized field is a contributor mistake worth failing CI on), with one addition: optional `tags` (SPEC F165.1) for the shelf card. No `license`/`sourceUrl` here — per-asset licensing already lives in the manifest's own `license`/`attribution` fields (SPEC F165.4), since a single pack can mix CC0 and CC-BY assets under different terms.
$comment: `added`'s pattern ends in (?![\s\S]), the same portable absolute-end-of-string anchor persona-meta.schema.json/theme-meta.schema.json/font-meta.schema.json/ad-pack-meta.schema.json document in full and repeat verbatim — repeated here too so this file stands alone.

author.description: Who built or curated the pack — the contributor's own handle or name.

description.description: A short blurb introducing the pack's sound — shown on the shelf card without fetching the manifest.

audience.description: Content self-rating, verified at review (mirrors every other kind's own `audience`).

added.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) this entry was added to the catalog. `format: date` alone is annotation-only in draft-07 by default, so `pattern` carries the shape enforcement — but pattern alone only checks digit counts, not calendar validity; tools/validate.py separately parses this value with datetime.date.fromisoformat to reject a shape-valid but non-existent date.

bestFor.description: Optional use-case hints ("talk station", "top of hour") — mirrors every other kind's own `bestFor`.

tags.description: Optional short lowercase tokens for the shelf card (SPEC F165.1) — a browsing aid, never matched against anything at install or generation time.
